# Charge review templates

Placeholders are illustrative. Fill them only from the record and verified authority.

## Charge sufficiency matrix

| Charge | Element (verified text, source) | Evidence relied on | Source and pinpoint | Admissibility basis or "unresolved" | Contrary or missing evidence | Standard tested (probable cause, sufficiency, beyond a reasonable doubt) | Result in words |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Run the table once per standard. Do not copy a result from one standard to another.

## Witness reliability review

| Witness | Role | What the State uses the witness for | Prior statements (source) | Bias, motive, or relationship (source) | Consistency with independent evidence | History relevant to credibility (source) | Treatment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

"Treatment" is examine, test against independent evidence, or flag the State's reliance as flawed logic. It is never "disregard" (adaptation 5). Cite any history of dishonesty and test the specific testimony against independent evidence.

## Misconduct lead log

| Lead ID | Type (Brady, Giglio, fabrication, alteration, charging, other) | What the record shows | What is missing | Who knew, and when | What would confirm it | R10 class | Filing-ready? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

"Filing-ready" is yes only when each allegation about a named official is tied to cited record evidence (K6). Otherwise the lead stays in working files.

## Disclosure checklist

| Item | Why it matters (issue it serves) | Evidence it exists (source) | Held by | Request made (date, method) | Response | Next step |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Knowledge-at-the-time table

| Warning sign or defect | What the prosecution had at the time | Source for that knowledge | Date | What is known only now | Source for the later knowledge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Opposing-method audit

| State argument (quote, source) | Method named (causal claim, inference from silence or absence, pattern from few instances, credibility by status) | Where it appears in the record | Answer with cited facts, or risk entry |
|---|---|---|---|

## Recommendation block

State the recommended action, the verified authority for it, the conditions under which it fails, and what remains UNVERIFIED. Describe strengths and weaknesses in words. A 1-10 scorecard may sit in a local working file only (K7).
